input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: Structurally the clause looks acceptable — the cap is expressly mutual (21.1), the exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is mutual with a helpful direct-damages list (21.2), and the "Excluded Claims" definition (21.3) carves out confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not "damages". The failure is the cap base: "Fees" is defined at 1.5 as only the "Implementation Fee", which 1.6 fixes as a one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form, and 21.1 further narrows it to that first Order Form. The recurring subscription and services charges are therefore excluded, so the cap is an illusory USD 12,000 rather than twelve months' fees — far below the six-month floor and in walk-away territory. Redline resets the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable in the preceding twelve months or USD 1,000,000, leaving mutuality and the carve-outs untouched.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis in 21.1: greater of all amounts paid or payable in prior 12 months or USD 1,000,000
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is tied to the defined term Fees, which is only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the limitation is illusory and sits far below six months' charges. We have reset the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months or USD 1,000,000; the cap stays mutual and Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside it. A straight twelve-month all-Order-Form fee cap is our fallback if the fixed floor is an issue.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.
